text.title: Ember Reckoning
text.body: Final Chapter — Path of Ember (Ending B). Inside the blazing Furnace Heart of the Obsidian Caldera, demolish the West and East Obsidian Conduit Pillars feeding the iron throne, then strike down Ember Overlord Vorak ('The Living Kiln') and claim the Crown of Thorns and Cinder.
text.obj.0: Break the West and East Conduit Pillars
text.obj.1: Defeat Ember Overlord Vorak inside the Furnace Heart
text.msg.1: Vorak looks at humanity through the eye of a smelter's kiln. To him, our cities are slag and our blood is fuel for the Great Cleansing. Break the two obsidian conduit pylons feeding his throne—or he will turn this entire continent into an open crematorium!
text.msg.2: The West Obsidian Conduit cracks and goes cold!
text.msg.3: The East Obsidian Conduit shatters—his molten regeneration is severed!
text.msg.4: Both conduits are gone—cinder-imps and magma-elementals erupt from the central fissure!
text.msg.5: Melt! Burn away the weakness! Look upon the kiln, little borderer—only fire reveals what deserves to endure!
text.msg.6: Burn, then... conqueror... take the Crown... and see if it does not melt your bones as it melted mine...
text.win: Vorak sinks beneath the magma, leaving the blazing Crown of Thorns and Cinder waiting for a sovereign hand.
text.fail.1: Your hero fell inside the Furnace Heart.
